components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 600 1rem system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--field, #6379a8); color: var(--text, #e8eef7); background: transparent; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #7db0ff); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #a9ccff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { color: var(--on-primary, #07122c); background: var(--primary, #7db0ff); border-color: var(--primary, #7db0ff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #7db0ff) 86%, var(--text, #e8eef7)); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-2 { font: 600 1rem system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--field, #6379a8); color: var(--text, #e8eef7); background: transparent; } .ds-btn-2:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #7db0ff); } .ds-btn-2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #a9ccff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Tab
components.description: Navigation item; selected state lifts to the raised fill.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 208px; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font: 500 1rem system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--mfg, #a9b6d0); background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background .15s, color .15s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text, #e8eef7); background: var(--panel-2, #18254d); } .ds-tab[aria-selected=true] { color: var(--text, #e8eef7); background: var(--panel-2, #18254d); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #a9ccff); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.css: .ds-metric { --ink: var(--ink-hrv, #ff5a64); display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 260px; padding: 16px; background: var(--panel, #111b38); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #25335e); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--text, #e8eef7); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mhead { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--mfg, #a9b6d0); } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink); } .ds-pill { margin-left: auto; padding: 1px 8px; font-size: .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #25335e); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-mval { font-size: 2.125rem; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-unit { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--mfg, #a9b6d0); } .ds-msub { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--mfg, #a9b6d0); } .ds-spark { width: 100%; height: 40px; margin-top: 8px; overflow: visible; } .ds-spark path { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }

components.name: Readiness Hero
components.description: Poster numeral and zoned scale on a tone-washed panel.
components.html:
62of 100
Typical
Train as planned.
components.css: .ds-hero { --tone: var(--st-typical, #8fb8ff); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr; gap: 16px 32px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #25335e); border-radius: 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tone) 11%, var(--panel, #111b38)); color: var(--text, #e8eef7); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-score { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-n { font-size: 7rem; line-height: 1.3; margin-block: -.14em; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-of { color: var(--mfg, #a9b6d0); } .ds-state { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tone); } .ds-scale { position: relative; margin: 16px 0; height: 12px; } .ds-zones { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-zones i { display: block; height: 100%; } .ds-zones i:nth-child(1) { width: 30%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--st-strained, #ff6b6b) 80%, var(--panel, #111b38)); } .ds-zones i:nth-child(2) { width: 20%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--st-below, #ffa04d) 80%, var(--panel, #111b38)); } .ds-zones i:nth-child(3) { width: 20%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--st-typical, #8fb8ff) 80%, var(--panel, #111b38)); } .ds-zones i:nth-child(4) { width: 30%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--st-well, #4fdc8e) 80%, var(--panel, #111b38)); } .ds-marker { position: absolute; left: 62%; top: -6px; width: 4px; height: 24px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--text, #e8eef7); transform: translateX(-50%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--panel, #111b38); } .ds-verdict { align-self: center; font-size: 2.125rem; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.015em; color: var(--tone); }

narrative.overview:
A phone in a dim room at 6:40am, or a laptop at a desk: the same calm, dense panel. A midnight-navy enamel ground carries deeper panels, porcelain text and hairline rules, and every Garmin or computed signal is given one vivid ink that it keeps on every surface. The category standard, played straight: sidebar and cards, system type, standard controls. Its one loud moment is the readiness numeral, set at poster size on a panel washed with the tone of the advice.

Density is deliberate: enough real data stays visible to justify the verdict. Depth is tonal, never decorative. Dark is the default theme; the light theme is composed separately (not an inversion) in a prefers-color-scheme: light block, so the hues of the inks are kept but each value is re-picked for contrast on white panels.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ground, three tonal surface steps, hairline borders, no shadows.
One ink per signal, repeated in dot, value line, sparkline, bars and charts.
Poster tabular numeral against 12 to 14px readouts.
System UI type only; 44px controls; sidebar on laptop, bottom tab bar on phone.
Every number sits next to the owner's own "usual".

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: A signal has exactly one ink and uses it everywhere; an ink is never reused for another signal or for decoration.

rules.name: The Tone Wash Rule
rules.body: The advice tone washes the hero panel at 11% and colors the verdict text; no other panel is tinted.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Text meets 4.5:1 and inks and graphics 3:1 in both themes, verified from the tokens. New inks are checked in both before they ship.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (score, metric values, tables, insight figures) is tabular.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: System UI only. Chart.js is pointed at the same stack through Chart.defaults.font.family.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. State is shown by border color or a step up the tonal ladder, never a shadow or glow.

dos: Do give every new signal one ink, declared as --ink-* in both themes, and route it through data-ink.
Do place each value beside the owner's "usual" and the delta from it.
Do use the six-step spacing scale and 10px/14px radii.
Do keep controls at 44px and keep focus visible (2px ring, 2px offset).
Do say what is computed here: the readiness score and load ratio are not Garmin metrics, and the UI states it.
Do compose a new color for light separately and check it at 4.5:1 (text) or 3:1 (ink, graphics).
donts: Don't replace the hero with a gauge ring plus equal-weight cards.
Don't add glows, gradients, drop shadows or blurred backdrops.
Don't use color as the only cue for state; pair it with a word, arrow or sign.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a non-tabular figure for changing numbers.
Don't reuse one signal's ink for another signal or for decoration.
Don't tint any panel other than the hero with the advice tone.
